name: autosota-codex
description: Lightweight paper-to-SOTA loop: paper PDF + target metrics + local code repo to optimized model (Codex orchestration)
author: autosota contributors

scripts.postinstall:
node -e "try{const fs=require('fs'),p='dist/codex-shim-bin/claude'; if(fs.existsSync(p)) fs.chmodSync(p,0o755); console.log('
\x1b[32m[autosota-codex]\x1b[0m installed (Codex CLI bundled). Next steps:
  codex login           # or set CODEX_API_KEY
  autosota init         # scaffold ./config.yaml + ./paper/
  autosota doctor       # verify python3, Codex, git, etc.
  autosota --repo /path/to/your-clone
')}catch(e){}"
